== Notes ==
* Effective against [[Assassin]]s who use [[Critical Strikes]] to manage their energy.
* As with any [[doublecast skill]], [[NPC]]s will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's [[area of effect]] range of an ally.
* Foes suffer two damage [[packet]]s if the caster is targeted.
* If a foe is targeted when Stone Sheath is cast, then the enchantment will automatically target the ally nearest to the foe.
